    """Final LayerNorm with four bias directions absorbed by token-row means."""

        super().__init__(normalized_shape)

        for j in range(normalized_shape - 4):
            scale = math.sqrt((j + 1) * (j + 2))
            basis[: j + 1, j] = 1.0 / scale
            basis[j + 1, j] = -(j + 1) / scale

            persistent=False,
